title: PeaceSMP
description: A server-driven alignment mod introducing an advanced Karma tracking system,  and game-changing combat abilities for survival multiplayer.
body:
Everyone starts at Value 5 (Neutral, White Name).

 **🛡️ Pacifist/Trapper Path**

Earn peaceful minutes by not hitting any player. (The timer pauses if you AFK).

* **Value 6 (60 minutes):** Grants **Luck IV (Crazy for fishing btw, has a 20% chance to catch treasure items from fishing with luck of the sea 3 fishing rod)**. (Green Name)
* **Value 7 (+120 minutes):** Grants **+4 Max Health** (2 Extra Hearts). (Green Name)
* **Value 8 (+120 minutes):** Grants **+8 Max Health** (4 Extra Hearts in total). (Green Name)
* **Value 9 (+300 minutes):** Grants **Resistance I**. (Aqua Name)
* **Value 10 (+300 minutes):** Unlocks **Vanish Ability** (Sneak + Right-click with Phantom Membrane to gain Invisibility for 30s. 10m cooldown). (Aqua Name)

 **⚔️ PvPer Path (Requires Unique Player Kills)**

Rank up by killing other players. (Has a 4-hour cooldown per specific victim to prevent kill-farming).

* **Value 4 (1 Kill):** Grants **Bonus XP** from animals. (Yellow Name)
* **Value 3 (5 Kills):** Grants **+2.0 Attack Damage**. (Yellow Name)
* **Value 2 (10 Kills):** Grants **Strength I**. (Red Name)
* **Value 1 (25 Kills):** Grants **Strength II**. (Red Name)
* **Value 0 (50 Kills):** Unlocks **Blood Ability** (Sneak + Right-click with Blaze Rod to gain Regeneration II for 10s. 10m cooldown). (Dark Red Name)

**🌟 Secret Path (Nr.1):**

*Limited to 1 player per server.* Unlocked via a rare 0.05% chance when getting a kill or every 30 peaceful minutes. It removes all effects and abilities form the normal paths and replaces them with active skills (Gold Name):

* **Sky Drop (Shift right-click with Wind Charge):** Launch into the air and slam down, dealing 5 hearts of explosive damage (10m cooldown).
* **Arena (Shift right-click with  Iron Bars):** Create a flaming 5-block radius barrier that traps players inside for 15 seconds (10m cooldown).
* **Anti-Heal zone (Shift right-click with  Fermented Spider Eye):** Emits a 15-block wave that completely locks enemy health and stops all healing for 10 seconds (10m cooldown).

**🔒 Built for Servers (Anti-Exploit Mechanics)**
PeaceSMP is designed with server admins in mind. You cannot cheat this system.

* **Anti-AFK Tracker:** Players cannot sit in a dirt hole or AFK at a mob farm to reach Value 10. The server actively tracks chunk movement and XP gain. If you aren't moving and interacting, your peaceful timer completely freezes.
* **Kill-Farming Cooldown:** Friends cannot repeatedly kill each other at spawn to reach Value 0. When you kill a player, they are put on a strict 30-Minute Cooldown. Successive kills on that same player yield no Karma points until the timer resets. You must hunt different players.
* **The Death Penalty:** High stakes PvP! If you die to a player your kill count is lowered by 1. If you die too many times, you will lose your PvPer ranks and buffs, ensuring only the best fighters keep the top spots.

**🛠️ Admin Commands (Requires OP)**

* `/peace info [player]` - Check a player's Karma value, exact kill count, and hidden timers.
* `/peace setvalue <player> <0-10>` - Manually set a player's Karma rank.
* `/peace addkill <player>` - Give a player a kill point (bypasses the 4-hour victim cooldown).
* `/peace reset <player>` - Completely wipe a player's stats and return them to Value 5.
* `/peace resetcooldowns <player>` - Instantly refresh all active ability timers.
* `/peace setsecret <player> <0/1>` - Forcibly grant (1) or remove (0) the Ascendant secret class.
* `/peace setcooldown <minutes>` - Changes the timer for the kill to count again on the same player.
